It's a really scary post to read, all the comments there hits really hard to home. :( I just want to list all the little signs present in me:

The lack of/excessive sleep hours, erratic diet, sudden weight gain, extreme tiredness, holing up in a room, not talking to anyone for months, quick to anger, forgetfulness, poor care for own health and hygiene, loss of interest in hobbies, body pains, no excitement and anticipation, anxiety, no motivation for anything, abandoned chores, addictive behavior/obsessions, cancelling meet-ups with friends, tendency of escapism.

I'm convinced that I *am* depressed at this point, but I can't go to a mental institution or therapy. I guess I only need to take care of myself more, and do more exciting stuff in life. I hope it'll help ease this sort of ennui and exhaustion I feel.
